text:
Priya K.: Heads-up: Aurora Systems PO #A-9007 failing import in marketplace portal. Error shows encoding=UTF-16LE and BOM present. They say their SAP instance outputs UTF-16 little-endian. Anyone seen this pattern?
invoice-bot: Ingest attempt logged. event_id=aur-9007-2026, status=attachment_rejected, error=unsupported_charset, content_type=application/xml; charset=UTF-16LE
Sam R. (Procurement): If partner can flip to UTF-8 it's ideal but they have a freeze window until tomorrow evening. Need a stopgap to avoid blocking the reseller launch.
Lina (Finance): Our parser pipeline assumes UTF-8 and validates signature against binary. We cannot accept altered bytes without preserving original and recording every transform.
Tessa (Legal): Legal: we can allow a transformation if we preserve the original file, record the conversion steps, and have partner confirm the PO metadata (PO#, signatory email) in Slack or via a signed statement.
Kai @ Aurora Systems: Confirming signer is Miguel Alvarez (miguel@auroracorp.com). DocuSign envelope 45210 attached in original email thread. We can provide an attestation message if it helps.
Oncall Ops: We can implement a temporary lambda-based converter that saves original to S3 (s3://enc-archive/aurora/A-9007/original.xml), runs `python -c "import codecs,sys; sys.stdout.write(codecs.open('in.xml','r','utf-16').read())" > out.xml` and computes SHA256 for both files. Will need finance + legal ack before execution. Estimated 2 hrs to run, plus QA.
Lina (Finance): OK if you store original, record both checksums, and add metadata: `original_charset=UTF-16LE`, `conversion_utility=aurora-lambda-v1`, `converted_by=oncall_ops`. We'll attach GL code rev_5042 once ingested.
Tessa (Legal): Legal requires chain-of-custody note and that the converted file is marked "for ingest only"; original remains authoritative. Also request partner to include a short signed confirmation: "I confirm PO A-9007 is final and matches the attached XML" with timestamp.
Sam R. (Procurement): Procurement will accept Slack-attested confirmation from Kai + envelope id if Legal signs off. Kai, can you post the attestation now?
Kai @ Aurora Systems: Posting attestation: "I, Miguel Alvarez, confirm PO A-9007 is final and corresponds to DocuSign envelope 45210." -- Miguel Alvarez (miguel@auroracorp.com) :paperclip:
invoice-bot: External attestation recorded for audit. ref=aur-9007-attest-45210
Oncall Ops: Starting conversion dry-run on a copy. Command used: ```aws s3 cp s3://aurora-drop/A-9007/raw.xml /tmp/raw.xml && python3 - <<'PY'
import codecs,hashlib
with codecs.open('/tmp/raw.xml','r','utf-16le') as f:
    data=f.read()
with open('/tmp/converted.xml','w',encoding='utf-8') as out:
    out.write(data)
for p in ['/tmp/raw.xml','/tmp/converted.xml']:
    h=hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    print(p, h)
PY
```
Oncall Ops: Dry-run produced checksums: raw_sha256=abc123... (redacted), conv_sha256=def456... (redacted). Uploaded both to s3://enc-archive/aurora/A-9007/ with metadata.
Lina (Finance): Received checksums and metadata. Finance approves ingestion for payment after final portal push. Please include GL tag `rev_5042` and note `manual_conversion=true`.
Tessa (Legal): Confirmed archive location and attestation captured. Legal signs off on one-time conversion with the controls listed. Recommend adding to partner-facing KB: "If your ERP emits UTF-16, supply both original and an attest; our team can perform conditional ingest."
Priya K.: I'll update the Aurora onboarding checklist and create a short runbook for partnerships KB with the exact steps and required attestation template. Also logging this ticket as PARTN-2026-9007.
Sam R. (Procurement): Thanks all. Procurement will update the PO status to "processing" once portal accepts the converted file. Kai, please stand by for a confirmation ping after ingestion.
Oncall Ops: Portal push complete. status=ingested_staging. Final checksum recorded. Correlation=aur-9007-0be3.
invoice-bot: Ingestion event recorded. payment_hold cleared pending final QA.
Kai @ Aurora Systems: Confirmed receipt and that the reseller launch schedule is unchanged. Appreciate the rapid help.
Priya K.: Closing internal thread. Will publish runbook and flag engineering to evaluate adding UTF-16 sniff & safe-convert to the pipeline for known partners. :white_check_mark:
